source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with layered misty cliffs, wooded hills, hidden pavilion roofs, rocky foreground banks, willows, and calm water. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_clifftop_plateau
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central mesa-like cliff with a flat ochre ledge and dense dark foliage crowning the top. Include the vertical cliff face, hanging ink wash streaks, small side shrubs, and soft mist at the lower base, but exclude the calligraphy and neighboring right cliff mass.
must_preserve: flat angular ochre cliff-top geometry
dense dotted treetop texture along the rim
vertical ink wash streaks down the rock face
dark crevice linework and dry-brush rock texture
soft fading mist edge at the lower cliff base

motifs.name: right_mist_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side rounded cliff formation with a dark vegetated cleft descending between rock masses. Include the shrub-covered summit, vertical rock washes, mist-wrapped lower portion, and pale distant peak behind it only where attached visually to this mountain group.
must_preserve: rounded cliff silhouette
dark diagonal ravine filled with stippled foliage
vertical grey-brown wash texture
thin contour strokes on rock planes
mist-softened lower edge

motifs.name: left_hazy_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the low, receding hills and ridges on the left mid-background beneath the inscription area. Include only the misty layered mountain silhouettes and sparse ridge vegetation, excluding seals, calligraphy, and foreground trees.
must_preserve: pale atmospheric wash layers
soft overlapping ridge contours
small dotted shrubs along ridge tops
faint distant peak silhouettes
blurred mist transitions between hills

motifs.name: hidden_hillside_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the wooded hillside village cluster in the left-middle area: dark rooflines partly hidden among dense trees, backed by pines and mixed foliage. Include the slope immediately supporting the buildings and the interlaced tree canopy, but exclude unrelated foreground rocks and the central large slab rock.
must_preserve: thin black roofline geometry with upturned eaves
partly obscured pavilion roofs among trees
dense rounded leaf-dot clusters
pine needle sprays behind the roofs
brown hillside wash and fine contour strokes

motifs.name: central_slanted_rock_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent slanted rock slab in the central foreground-midground with surrounding shrubs and small trees. Include the pale tilted rock face, dark lower creases, foliage beads along the ridge, and adjacent branching trees, but avoid the hidden pavilion cluster to the left.
must_preserve: large diagonal pale rock silhouette
dry-brush vertical and diagonal rock texture
dark ink accents at the rock base
small stippled shrubs along the crest
fine branching trees around the slab

motifs.name: willow_inlet_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the right-midground water inlet with drooping willows, low banks, and a small angular bridge or walkway crossing near the trees. Include the calm horizontal water strokes and bank contours, but exclude the broad lower river expanse.
motifs.role: water inlet with willows and bridge
must_preserve: drooping willow branch linework
small bridge or walkway geometry
horizontal waterline strokes
curving bank edges
light ochre ground wash with dark reed accents

motifs.name: left_foreground_terraces_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground terraced bank with gnarled trees, layered earth ledges, small rocks, and the stream or cascade at the bottom-left corner. Include the stepped ochre ground planes and dense foliage, but exclude the calligraphy area and upper pavilion roofs.
must_preserve: gnarled trunks with fine branching
dense stippled foliage masses
stepped terrace contours in ochre wash
dark rock outlines and textured boulders
small flowing stream marks at the lower left

motifs.name: lower_right_river_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the broad calm river surface and curving shoreline in the lower-right portion. Include the empty water plane, horizontal ink ripples, dotted shore vegetation, and small bank rocks, while excluding the willow inlet and central foreground rocks as much as possible.
must_preserve: broad pale open water wash
thin horizontal ripple strokes
curving shoreline contour
small dotted vegetation along the bank
subtle rocks and low shore forms at the water edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
